Who is a Stranger?

Published

December 11, 2021

Modified

July 6, 2026

Introduction: The Company of Strangers!

How many strangers do you “meet” everyday?

Why is the Human Species different from all others?

Those two questions are not unrelated !! The Human Species is perhaps unique in that we are able to cooperate with strangers

Yes! Do you think that designing things, building and conducting a business, or making art is something like that? No? Well, let us see a few quick stories!!

Story-1

Do you know who these four people are ?

The Hero’s Journey


This is the story of a young man who leaves home from Tarbes, in Gascony, France, to travel to Paris to make his fortune. He has two blessings,one each from his mother and his father. True to the instructions given by his Dad, and his very Gascon nature, he picks a fight even before he reaches Paris.

Classic Movie Time!

Let us watch a (very very) small part of this movie, The Three Pangas Musketeers-1973. Here is the IMDB page for film buffs.

Classic Fiction Time!

Let us read aloud(!!) a bit of good old classic fiction !! This is the Conversation that occurs right before the duel scene we saw in the video above.Chapter 5. THE KING’S MUSKETEERS AND THE CARDINAL’S GUARDS.1

Discussion-1

  • Why are they TALKING, when they have come here to FIGHT?? “When have to shoot, shoot! Don’t talk!” said Eli Wallach.
  • Pardon,m’sieu, but why were they so polite to each other? (Oh, These French…)
  • Were they talking as if they didn’t want to fight?
  • But to “have fought already”?
  • The Shadow of the Future on the Present

Story-2

What about this game ?

Discussion-2

What emotions or motivations are portrayed by the characters in the story? We can think of the “4Rs”:

  • Reward
  • Regret aka FOMO
  • Risk
  • Retribution/Punishment

Nice Guys Finish First

Nice Guys ( Gals also, why not? ) finish First

Wait, But Why?

  • Many public behaviours require us to trust strangers
  • We have Rule of Law based on this trust
  • If there is no C at first, then everybody does a D
  • That is the source of the Dilemma
  • As Artists and Designers, and Creators, we need to practice our craft that in such a way as to induce niceness…
  • So what will you make? A movie? An ad? A public sign-board? A street play? An illustration? A “spatial arrangement”? A policy or a law?

Design Situations with Game Theory?

  • RWAs, pets, animals, and children. Sigh.
  • Public Spaces: Malls, Theaters, Trains, Busses…
  • Street Traffic, Pedestrians, and Rules. (and Signage)
  • Garbage, Littering, Noise..public (and not so public ) behaviour
  • Families, Siblings, and Household Chores
  • Parenting
  • Offices, Colleagues, and other pests

Assignment-1

Take a walk in the nearest urban area this weekend. Unobtrusively, observe what people are doing. Note these down when they seem to be visible examples of “Cooperate” or “Defect”. For or Against whom? Discuss the Actions, and the possible payoff values. Draw up a Payoff Matrix is possible. ( Some Actions will of course have to be “predicted” since you do not observe the entire vocabulary of Actions they might perform.)
